title: Residence permits, moving to Switzerland and naturalisation - MVP sources (federal and Canton Zurich)

scope.description: MVP scope: Swiss federal foundations for residence permits plus Canton of Zurich and City of Zurich entry points, extended on 15 September 2026 with the topics a newly arrived resident meets next (social insurance on arrival and departure, tax at source, the foreign driving licence, health insurance and premium reduction) and with naturalisation, at the same three levels. Other cantons are in the swiss-residence pack. Extended on 17 September 2026 with the contact pages of the Zurich offices these topics name: addresses, opening and telephone hours and directions where published. Extended again on 17 September 2026 with the daily-life duties of a newcomer in the City of Zurich: waste, parking and vehicles, dogs, school, taxes, the radio and television fee and emergencies. Extended on 18 September 2026 with voting rights and the Zurich tax-at-source tariff pages, and with the questions of expats settling in: family allowances and parental leave, housing and rent, customs on moving, marriage, pillar 3a, unemployment, accident insurance and leaving the City of Zurich. Extended on 23 September 2026 with the registration route of all 26 cantons: who takes the registration of an arriving resident and in what order, the deadline each canton states for it, how the canton takes a permit application, its online services and what it publishes about moving in from another canton. Only those subjects are cantonal at that breadth; every other topic of the pack remains federal plus Canton and City of Zurich. Nine cantons publish the deadline only in cantonal law, so consolidated statutes are catalogued beside the service pages.
exclusions: Tax tariff tables, premium and allowance calculators, individual amounts

language_discovery.selection_policy: Prefer a verified official German seed when choosing only one language version for a limited MVP run. Named scan sets and explicit --source selectors retain every selected language version, with German seeds scheduled first. Keep the recorded local language when no German equivalent has been verified; never guess translated URL slugs or silently fall back after a failed crawl.

build_notes: Only source references and operator-authored planning metadata are stored. No pages, quotations, legal claims, extracted topics/concepts, facts or rules are included.
Ready means eligible for a later test, not verified live, robots-approved, complete, authoritative on every linked topic or extraction-ready.
Robots, redirects, public-network checks and request/byte/time limits are enforced by SafeCrawler at run time. Query URLs remain disabled. Do not submit forms or log in.
Defaults scan the five smoke seeds only and do not make requests unless --crawl is supplied. Limits are per source and aggregate ceilings are printed in the plan.
Planning topic hints are for operator selection only. Do not feed them as expected concepts to source-first extraction or human annotation.
HTML content capture is opt-in at a later operator run. PDF documents and JavaScript-only applications need later adapters; record exclusions instead of claiming successful extraction.
Record requested/final URL, retrieval time, byte hash, content type, declared/detected language, source identity and jurisdiction with every later snapshot. Preserve municipal applicability.
Run the existing concepts CLI on saved pages. Cross-document topic clustering, review, supported operations and release publication remain later build stages.

German is preferred for single-version MVP seeds and crawl ordering. Multilingual selections retain all chosen official versions; candidate parallel page groups require later content alignment. Evidence selection is a planned separate policy and must not equate German preference with legal precedence.

The scan set entry selects these seeds. The draft-5 catalogue needs a new run directory; the draft-4 run is carried over with its hashes before the new pages are downloaded.

Extension of 18 September 2026 (voting rights and tax-at-source tariffs): the Federal Constitution (SR 101) and the Constitution of the Canton of Zurich (SR 131.211) are legal-basis seeds fetched through the Fedlex plugin; the Canton of Zurich page on who may vote and the ch.ch page on the right to vote are registry seeds; the Canton of Zurich tariff page and the calculation parameters of the current tax-at-source tariffs (PDF) are explicit links under the existing seed zh-tax-at-source, whose path allowlist gains the tax-at-source document folder. The family allowance, parental leave and customs sources of the earlier extensions join the scan set expat-life unchanged. The draft-7 catalogue is re-planned in place; saved pages, Fedlex documents and text records are kept.

Extension of 19 September 2026 (English versions): the English versions of the SEM, FOPH, FOCBS, SECO and SERAFE pages the release cites, and the German version of the SEM residence overview whose English version it cites, are explicit links in their own section of sources.md, without registry seeds. They were found through the German pages' declared language alternates and checked live; a fact cites the English passage next to the German one only after the two were compared. evidence_selection_policy.eligibility: Apply explicit scope, jurisdiction, applicability, effective date and source_languages filters before ranking evidence. Query and answer languages never imply a source-language filter.
evidence_selection_policy.ranking: Prefer authoritative, current evidence that supports the requested claim. German is only a final tie-breaker among verified equivalent, equally suitable official versions.
evidence_selection_policy.duplicate_support: Group verified equivalent sections of compatible source revisions when selecting evidence; translations of one source do not count as independent corroboration. Retain all source references and expose material differences or conflicts.
evidence_selection_policy.identity: Reviewed concept equivalence permits shared language-neutral concept IDs and multilingual term metadata. Documents, snapshots, sections, evidence IDs, URLs, source languages and hashes remain independently identified.
evidence_selection_policy.answer_language: The calling LLM chooses the answer language independently and cites the selected original evidence. Localized retrieval metadata is not factual evidence.
